body.message: Signal decoding requires Linux with util-linux prlimit and REA_SIGROK_COMMAND so expanded recordings are processed under an enforced address-space limit. On Linux, configure sigrok-cli 0.7.2 through REA_SIGROK_COMMAND and util-linux prlimit through REA_SIGROK_PRLIMIT_COMMAND (default /usr/bin/prlimit).
